# Workforce Time Tracker

> Offline desktop time tracker for Windows + macOS that auto-detects work from your active browser tab. Hours stay in plain JSON files on your own machine - no vendor cloud account and no telemetry. One licence covers both platforms. A 14-day trial is available without an account or credit card.

## Key facts

- **Platforms:** Windows 10/11 (64-bit), macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon (alpha)
- **Pricing:** EUR 5/user/month or EUR 50/user/year. One purchase, both platforms. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
- **Data location:** Plain human-readable JSON files in a folder you control. Default is next to the .exe (Windows) or `~/Library/Application Support/WorkforceTimeTracker/` (macOS).
- **Privacy:** No vendor cloud and no telemetry. The only optional outbound call is a version check that can be disabled in Settings. Customers remain responsible for their own devices and sync providers.
- **Multi-device sync:** Point the app at any folder you already sync. For strict EU-only or air-gapped handling, use SyncThing, an internal share, or a NAS. Dropbox, OneDrive, and iCloud are optional third-party providers that the customer must assess. We do not run a sync server.
- **GDPR posture:** We do not receive your time-entry data. The customer remains responsible for its own processing decisions, devices, payment data, and chosen sync providers.
- **Licence model:** Per-user named licence, RSA-PSS-signed, validated locally with no server contact. No per-machine activation lock.
- **Early access support:** Optional project support is arranged by email at support@workforcetimetracker.com. Support is separate from the app's local data and licensing model.
- **Compliance boundary:** The app stores plain, unencrypted JSON locally. Auto-tracking reads active window titles when enabled and may process sensitive work context; employers must provide notice and assess works-council, employee-monitoring, DPIA, and retention obligations.

## CRM auto-detection (window-title parsing only - never an API call)

The desktop app reads the title of your active browser tab on your own machine and parses out the record name. It does not log into your CRM, does not call any vendor API, and does not install anything inside Salesforce, Dynamics 365, Jira or Atlassian. Your CRM admin sees zero footprint.

- **Salesforce edition:** auto-detects Accounts, Opportunities, Cases, Contacts, Leads from Lightning Experience and Salesforce Classic tab titles
- **Dynamics 365 edition:** auto-detects Accounts, Cases, Opportunities, Work Orders, Contacts from Sales Hub, Customer Service Hub, Field Service and most model-driven apps
- **Standalone edition:** auto-detects ticket keys and project codes from Jira (Cloud / Server / Data Center / Service Management), Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Asana, Linear, Monday.com

Live write-back into the CRM is on the roadmap as an optional paid Connect add-on. Today the app exports to Excel / CSV / PDF invoice for manual import.

## Optional sections

### Frequently asked questions

- **Does this connect to my CRM?** No. The app reads the title of your active browser tab and parses out the record name. It never logs into any CRM, never calls any API, never installs anything inside the CRM.
- **Where is my data stored?** Plain, unencrypted JSON files in a folder you control. For strict EU-only handling, use SyncThing, an internal share, or a NAS. Commercial sync providers remain subject to the customer's own data-protection assessment.
- **Will it work air-gapped?** Yes. Zero outbound calls are required. The optional version check can be disabled in Settings. Licence validation is local cryptographic - no server contact ever.
- **Do I need an Article 28 Data Processing Agreement?** The app does not send time-entry data to us. Whether a DPA is needed depends on the organisation's own processing, payment, and sync-provider arrangements.
- **Can I transfer my licence to another machine?** Yes. Per-user named licence works on any number of your own devices. There is no per-machine activation lock.
- **Is there a mobile app?** No. Windows and macOS desktop only.
